title: Tensor comparison tail for scalar-extended inverse-image modules
statement: Let L ⊣ V be a geometric morphism of sheaf topoi, with L preserving finite limits. Let R and A be sheaves of commutative rings with an underlying-sheaf isomorphism eR : A ≅ L(R), and let c : A → S. Let I be the inverse-image module functor with natural underlying-sheaf comparison eI and explicit transport equations hI for addition and scalar multiplication through eR. Let T be sheafified scalar extension of I along c, on both objects and morphisms (hT and hTmap), with normalized insertion maps q. Let P have underlying-sheaf comparison eP with V, with explicit equations hP transporting addition and specifying its R-action via the adjunct of eR⁻¹ followed by c. Assume a module adjunction am : T ⊣ P whose hom equivalence has underlying mate equation hAdj. Then there exist tensor comparison isomorphisms T(M ⊗_R N) ≅ T(M) ⊗_S T(N), simultaneously natural in both variables and satisfying the displayed generalized pure-tensor normalization.

proof.text: Recover an AlgebraicInverseImage presentation with modules exactly I, ring underlying comparison eR.symm and module underlying comparison eI from the explicit operation-transport witnesses hI. The new recovery theorem proves ring-operation compatibility by testing hI on the regular module. Substitute its modules equality and identify its module comparison with eI using the heterogeneous equality.

Postcompose hTmap with the inverse objectwise equality cast. Associativity and cancellation of eqToHom give the scalar-extension map equation required by the existing canonical normalized comparison construction. Apply that construction with the recovered algebraic inverse image, c, T, hT and the sheaf adjunction L ⊣ V.

Unpack its insertion maps q-prime, tensor isomorphisms, simultaneous naturality and pure equation. Both q-prime and the specified q have the same sectionwise insertion-of-one formula by q_one and hq; function and sheaf extensionality identify them. Substitute this equality and specialize naturality. Explicitly unfold ringedComparisonPureCondition and ringedComparisonPure in the supplied pure equation, exposing the tensor-sheafification inverse and unit; then reassociate compositions to obtain exactly the stated conclusion. The supplied hP, am and hAdj are not needed by this route; their binders remain unchanged.

proof_origin.place: Tag 03EL: reuse the existing normalized tensor construction; Tags 03D2 and 03D7: derive its algebraic-lift interface from hI using the regular module

old_proof.text: Construct the comparison on sectionwise pure tensors by inserting 1 in each scalar factor. The balancing relations and sheafification universal property produce the map; the reverse map contracts the two scalar factors. Tensor induction proves the inverse identities, and the same pure-tensor calculation proves simultaneous naturality and the displayed generalized-element equation.
